title: Devices are behind the current Windows release

activeDays.text: Days within which a device must have checked in to be counted

maxMonthsBehind.text: Months behind the current build before a device is treated as unpatched

report.title: {Items.Count} active {Plural(Items.Count, 'device is', 'devices are')} more than {params.maxMonthsBehind} months behind on updates

messages.businessImpact: These devices are running with publicly documented vulnerabilities unpatched, while checking in normally, so nothing else in the service is flagging them.
remediation: Check the update ring covering them for a deferral, a pause or a missing deadline.
Look for a shared cause: a site, a hardware model or a network path.
messages.cannotSee: This measures which Windows release a device is on against the newest the Windows build list holds, not which monthly update it has: no fact the tool collects says whether last Tuesday's patch landed. A build the list does not carry a release date for is not judged, so an unfilled list reports nothing rather than everything.
